findings.evidence: Tab id is deterministic JSON(kind,channel,keyword). After closing an in-flight tab and submitting the identical request, no old tab remains so generation restarts at1. The old response sees the same new id+generation and passes load's stale-result check. A delayed success or error can overwrite the newer tab or clear its loading state.
findings.reproduction: Start request A; close its tab; search identical A again; let second resolve, then first resolve or reject. The first update matches the replacement tab.
findings.proposal: Use a monotonic per-request token independent of tab deletion, or unique tab instance identity plus stable query key. Closing/reopening must never recycle the response identity. Keep previous successful items and pagination states.
checks: Deferred first success and first error cannot affect reopened second result/loading/error
Closing an in-flight page load and reopening same query remains isolated
No new shared provider state or actual request cancellation assumptions

findings.location: scroll useLayoutEffect; SoopWorkspace.tsx hidden Explore wrapper; SoopWorkspace.css is-live-view
findings.evidence: The listener writes .soop-workspace.scrollTop while Explore is inactive and the layout effect depends only on selectedTab/savedOnly, not active. Switching to live hides Explore and makes the same scroller overflow:hidden; switching to a short library also changes its scroll range. Browser scroll clamping can overwrite the saved search position with0, and returning to Explore does not restore it.

findings.proposal: Snapshot Explore scroll before it becomes hidden, ignore hidden/inactive scroll events, restore when Explore becomes active. Prefer a source-owned Explore scroller if that avoids library/live interference without player remount.

findings.location: search catch and youtube-results empty rendering
findings.evidence: A first-page request rejection sets current.error and loading=false with empty items. Rendering shows the alert and unconditionally also '검색 결과가 없습니다.' because the empty branch checks only loading, not error. Unlike SOOP there is no direct retry for the failed tab.
findings.proposal: Render distinct initial/loading/error/empty states, with a retry bound to that exact tab request. Preserve loaded items on pagination error and never convert a rejection into empty success.
checks: Rejected first page shows failure+retry and no no-results text
Successful empty page alone shows no-results
Retry targets the failed tab even after editing the search form
Loaded items/scroll survive next-page failure

findings.location: youtube-search input/history, card/context handlers and global key listener
findings.evidence: Privacy masks card titles/images and tab labels but leaves the current input value and history strings visible. Search submit, card double-click/context actions, favorites and Ctrl+Enter download remain active because handlers lack the privacy guard used by SOOP. Existing test asserts only title text and images, so it misses input.value/history and actions.
findings.proposal: Retain underlying query/history/selection and player session, but present an empty disabled input, hide history and operation content, and guard private hidden-card actions/shortcuts consistently with SOOP. Do not clear accounts, media or user history.
checks: Privacy after an entered query/open history exposes no query in visible input/history
No search/download/favorite mutation via mouse or keyboard while private
Turning privacy off restores previous query/results/scroll; existing receiver identity persists
